titulo.estudio: わけだ と わけがない
titulo.alumno: Deducing with «わけだ» and rejecting with «わけがない»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «わけだ» presents a conclusion that follows from the information; «わけがない» denies that something is possible or reasonable.
texto: Don't take «わけだ» as a simple causal explanation. With ない, the nuance changes to a strong denial based on the situation.
まいにち れんしゅう した ん です ね。 じょうず な わけ です。 (So you practise every day. No wonder you're good at it.)
あんなに かんたん な もんだい を、 まちがえる わけ が ありません。 (There's no way you'd get such a simple problem wrong.)
